what: Function memo restore onto the frozen query graph: when the daemon image is mapped, restored function memos take their node from graph::frozen::FrozenGraph (section 0x0501, SALSA_GRAPH once it exists) and their edges from it through graph::frozen::Overlay, with no decode into the live edge array. A section whose layout hash or content hash does not match is an error (FrozenError), never a rebuild. Design: docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/graph.md section 3.
